label_review: Labels are on vertical -Y faces. In the four-row assembled layout, each rear-row front face sits about 0.1 mm from the bin in front. Those labels are occluded during ordinary front/top drawer use. An exposed upper label face is needed to meet read-without-lifting use.
verification_method: Direct OCP BRepAlgoAPI_Common on exported STEP shapes in assembled coordinates; sampled paths are rigid-motion checks, not flexure simulation.
